snippet.title: DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY | Opening Cinematic
snippet.description:
DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY – Pre-Register Now! Launching March 2026
Store URL: https://sqex.to/9PCrU

Warriors from the FINAL FANTASY series assemble in modern-day Tokyo to save the world from destruction in DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY.
Fight in a 3vs3 Team Boss Battle Arena, where two teams fight monsters and clash in a race to defeat the powerful boss faster than the enemy team!

Official Website: https://www.square-enix.com/ddff/en/
Official X (Twitter): https://x.com/DDFF_EN
Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DDFF/

© SQUARE ENIX / NHN PlayArt
CHARACTER DESIGN: MIKI YAMASHITA / TETSUYA NOMURA
#DDFF #DISSIDIA
